Name: RBI Cyber Security Framework for OCI
Description: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) cyber security and governance controls for cloud banking, payment systems, and financial entities on OCI.

Requirements.Name: Inventory Management & Asset Classification
Requirements.Description: Maintain an updated inventory of all cloud compute, storage, and networking assets.

Requirements.Name: Identity & Access Control: User Authentication & MFA
Requirements.Description: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all users accessing the OCI management console.

Requirements.Name: Password Policy & Credential Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong password complexity rules with a minimum of 14 characters.

Requirements.Name: Privileged Access Management & API Key Rotation
Requirements.Description: Rotate API keys and user authentication tokens every 90 days to prevent persistent unauthorized access.

Requirements.Name: Network Security & Ingress Traffic Boundary Filtering
Requirements.Description: Prohibit unrestricted internet ingress to SSH (port 22) and RDP (port 3389) on all subnets.

Requirements.Name: Database & Analytics Workload Network Isolation
Requirements.Description: Ensure database and analytics clusters are isolated in private subnets with no public internet ingress.

Requirements.Name: Data Protection & Public Access Blocking
Requirements.Description: Prohibit public read/write access to object storage buckets containing banking and customer records.

Requirements.Name: Customer-Managed Key (CMK) Encryption at Rest
Requirements.Description: Encrypt block storage volumes and object buckets with customer-managed keys in OCI Vault.

Requirements.Name: Cryptographic Key Lifecycle & Automatic Key Rotation
Requirements.Description: Enable automated annual key rotation for all master encryption keys in OCI Vault.

Requirements.Name: Vulnerability Detection & Security Posture Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Deploy Oracle Cloud Guard to continuously monitor tenancy security posture and alert on anomalies.

Requirements.Name: Comprehensive Audit Trail & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Maintain tamper-evident audit logs of all configuration and transactional events for a minimum of 365 days.

Requirements.Name: Data Backup & Business Continuity Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure automated backup schedules and recovery capabilities for OCI block storage volumes.
